instructions.aDotBrieflyLightsUpRememberItsLocationAn: A dot briefly lights up. Remember its location and its place in the sequence. The dot positions stay fixed throughout each task.
instructions.adaptivePracticeIncreasesDifficultyEvery: Adaptive practice increases difficulty every two tasks, faster after successful recalls. Later rounds reach eight dots, denser spatial grids, subtle differences with matching square counts, and shorter exposure/answer times. Hard mode starts at level 3.
instructions.afterEachDotAnswerAYesNoSpatialQuestionC: After each dot, answer a Yes/No spatial question. Check reflection across a vertical divider, matching under rotation, or line-figure addition/subtraction. Keep the remembered dots in mind.
instructions.afterTheFinalSpatialQuestionSelectAllRem: After the final spatial question, select all remembered dots in their original order. Numbers show your selection order. Undo or clear choices before submitting.
instructions.afterTheLastSpatialQuestionSelectAllReme: After the last spatial question, select all remembered dots in the order they appeared. Undo or clear selections before submitting.
instructions.answerYesOrNoToSymmetryRotationAndFigure: Answer Yes or No to symmetry, rotation, and figure addition/subtraction questions while keeping the sequence in mind. Timeouts count as unanswered and continue automatically.
instructions.keepDotLocationsInMindWhileAnsweringSpat: Keep dot locations in mind while answering spatial questions. Practice answers are not saved.
instructions.memoryAndSpatialAnswersAreScoredSeparate: Memory and spatial answers are scored separately. The session ends at the task limit or time limit; only submitted sequences are included in results.
instructions.noNoQuarterTurnRotationMakesThePatternsI: No. No quarter-turn rotation makes the patterns identical. A reflection alone does not count.
instructions.oneDotLightsUpBrieflyRememberItsPosition: One dot lights up briefly. Remember its position and its place in the sequence. The same dot field returns for the next flash and for recall.
instructions.rememberASequenceOfHighlightedDotsWhileA: Remember a sequence of highlighted dots while answering interleaved spatial questions, then recall the dots in order.
instructions.startThePracticeTaskToTryAllPhasesEach: Start the practice task to try all phases. Each spatial question has 15 seconds in this demo. A timeout counts as unanswered and continues to the next phase.

labels.additionCombinesTheLinesFromBothFiguresA: Addition combines the lines from both figures; an overlapping line appears once.
labels.noAtLeastOneSquareDiffersFromTheReflecti: No. At least one square differs from the reflection across the vertical divider.
labels.subtractionRemovesTheSecondFigureSLinesF: Subtraction removes the second figure's lines from the first figure.
labels.yesAQuarterTurnRotation090180Or270: Yes. A quarter-turn rotation (0°, 90°, 180°, or 270°) makes the patterns identical.
labels.yesTheRightPatternIsTheLeftPatternReflec: Yes. The right pattern is the left pattern reflected across the vertical divider.

results.theShownResultHasAMissingOrExtraLine: The shown result has a missing or extra line.
